zh.question: 人体姿态变化会如何影响基于 Wi-Fi 的身份识别？
zh.method: 多任务学习与动态交叉缝合单元，在身份和姿态识别任务间实现特征自适应融合。

en.question: How do changes in posture affect Wi-Fi-based identity recognition?
en.method: Multitask learning and dynamic cross-stitch units adaptively fuse features across identity and posture recognition.

zh.question: 如何优化复杂环境下大规模 IoT 网络的覆盖与能量效率？
zh.method: 结合深度强化学习（DRL）与图神经网络（GNN），动态调整智能反射面（IRS）的相位。

en.question: How can large IoT networks improve coverage and energy efficiency in complex environments?
en.method: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) and graph neural networks (GNN) dynamically adjust intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) phases.
